cron.monthlyAt: On day {{day}} of every month at {{time}}
cron.custom: Custom expression: check the next runs

schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.subtitle: Scans and inspections that run on their own, at the times and with the resource limits set here.
schedules.name: Name
schedules.cronHint: Five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month and day of week. Also accepts @daily, @weekly and @hourly.
schedules.timezoneHint: IANA name, such as America/Sao_Paulo. Times follow this zone, including daylight saving time.
schedules.profileHint: Limits the run's CPU, memory and disk usage.
schedules.missedPolicyHint: Applies when the service was stopped at the scheduled time.
schedules.incrementalHint: Reuses the result for files unchanged since the last scan.
schedules.confirmImpact: Upcoming runs will follow this rule automatically.
schedules.confirmImpactDisabled: The schedule is saved but paused: nothing runs until it is activated.
schedules.previewInvalid: Fix the expression or time zone to see the next runs.
schedules.previewEmpty: The expression produces no future times.
schedules.emptyDescription: Without a schedule, scans and inspections only run when someone starts them. Create one to check the server every day, outside peak hours.
schedules.emptyReader: Without a schedule, scans only run when someone starts them. Ask an operator to create one.
schedules.deleteImpact: It will create no new runs. Past runs and their findings remain.
schedules.pathsOptionalHint: Optional when accounts are chosen. One per line, starting with /.

resources.title: Resources
resources.subtitle: How much CPU, memory and disk each run may use, so checks do not weigh on the server.
resources.restored: Profile {{name}} is back to its preset values.
resources.profilesIntro: Presets are calculated for this server's hardware. The executor applies safety limits to any profile: never all cores and never more than 75% of memory without a local override.
resources.emptyDescription: The server returned no profiles. Check that the executor is running.
resources.executorError: The executor did not respond, so the hardware could not be read: {{cause}}
resources.freezerHint: Requires systemd 246 or newer and cgroup v2.
resources.noReserveHint: Local executor setting that allows exceeding the system reserve.

explain.cpu: Sum of cores: equals up to {{cores}} busy core(s).
explain.memory: Above this, the system stops the run instead of affecting the sites.
explain.ioWeight: From 1 to 10000: higher means more disk priority.
explain.workers: Files read at the same time.
explain.clamd: Files sent to ClamAV at the same time.
explain.nice: From 0 to 19: higher means the run yields more CPU to other processes.
explain.runtime: After this time, the run is stopped.
explain.maxFile: Larger files are left out of the analysis and show up in coverage.
explain.pressure: Above these thresholds the run reduces parallel reads and, if pressure persists, pauses between batches until it drops.

resources.restoreImpact: Adjustments made to this profile are discarded and it goes back to the values calculated for the hardware.
resources.removeImpact: The profile ceases to exist. Schedules that use it may not start until they get another profile.

form.intro: The server checks the limits before saving and refuses a profile that reserves too many resources, explaining why.
form.name: Profile name
form.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, up to 32 characters (e.g. overnight).
form.nameInvalid: Use only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit (up to 32 characters).
form.nameTaken: A profile with this name already exists. Pick another or edit the existing one.
form.notNumber: Enter a number equal to or greater than zero.
form.refused: The server refused the profile: {{reason}}. Adjust the values and save again.
form.cpuHint: In % of one core: 100 = one core, 200 = two.
form.cpuHintHw_one: In % of one core: 100 = one core. This server has {{count}} core ({{max}}%).
form.cpuHintHw_other: In % of one core: 100 = one core. This server has {{count}} cores ({{max}}%).
form.memoryHintHw: In MiB (1024 MiB = 1 GiB). Total server memory: {{total}}.
form.ioReadHint: 0 = no bandwidth ceiling, only the weight below.
form.confirmImpact: Upcoming runs with this profile use the new limits. Runs in progress do not change.
form.cpuHintHw_zero: In % of one core: 100 = one core. This server has {{count}} cores ({{max}}%).
form.pressureIntro: When server pressure goes above these thresholds, the scan slows down and resumes on its own when it drops.
form.pressureHint: From 0 to 100. 0 turns off throttling for this resource.

resources.pressureNowHint: Share of time some process waited for the resource, average of the last 10 s.
resources.pressureUnavailable: Unavailable: the kernel does not expose pressure (PSI)

suggestion.title: Hardware-based suggestion
suggestion.intro: Calculated from the cores, memory, disk type, average pressure over the last 5 minutes and the latest runs.
suggestion.basis: Basis: {{cpus}} cores, {{memory}} of memory, {{disk}} disk, load average of {{load}}.
suggestion.basisNoPsi: This kernel does not expose pressure (PSI).
suggestion.history_one: {{formatted}} recent run considered, {{percent}}% of the time throttled by pressure.
suggestion.history_other: {{formatted}} recent runs considered, {{percent}}% of the time throttled by pressure.
suggestion.historyNone: There are no runs with performance measurements yet.
suggestion.applyTitle: Apply the suggestion as a custom profile?
suggestion.applyImpactNew: Creates the Suggested profile with these limits. Schedules and scans can use it; no other profile changes.
suggestion.applyImpactUpdate: Replaces the limits of the Suggested profile with these. The next runs with it use the new values; runs in progress do not change.
suggestion.refused: The server refused the suggestion: {{reason}}. Recalculate and try again.

reasons.cpu_busy: Busy server (CPU pressure of {{pressure}}% and load of {{load_per_core}} per core): {{share}}% of the {{cpus}} cores, up to {{quota}}% CPU.
reasons.cpu_idle: Idle server (CPU pressure of {{pressure}}% and load of {{load_per_core}} per core): {{share}}% of the {{cpus}} cores, up to {{quota}}% CPU, always leaving one core free.
reasons.cpu_normal: Moderate load ({{load_per_core}} per core): half of the {{cpus}} cores, up to {{quota}}% CPU, leaving one core free for the system.
reasons.memory_normal: Maximum memory of {{max}}: {{percent}}% of {{total}}, at most 4 GiB.
reasons.memory_pressure: Memory pressure of {{pressure}}%: {{max}} ({{percent}}% of RAM, at most 2 GiB).
reasons.disk_hdd: Rotational disk: {{workers}} parallel reads, I/O weight {{io_weight}} and reads capped at {{io_read}}/s so sites are not delayed.
reasons.disk_ssd: SSD: {{workers}} parallel reads and I/O weight {{io_weight}}.
reasons.disk_nvme: NVMe: {{workers}} parallel reads and I/O weight {{io_weight}}.
reasons.workers_cpu: Parallel reads capped at {{workers}}: more would only compete for the same {{quota}}% CPU quota.
reasons.io_busy: I/O pressure of {{pressure}}%: half the parallel reads ({{workers}}) and I/O weight {{io_weight}}.
reasons.history_limited: The latest runs ({{runs}}) spent {{percent}}% of the time throttled by pressure: {{workers}} parallel reads.
reasons.nice: Priority (nice) {{nice}}: the scan yields CPU to the sites when they need it.
reasons.pressure_thresholds: Pressure throttling from CPU {{cpu}}%, I/O {{io}}% and memory {{memory}}%, above the server's typical pressure.
reasons.pressure_unavailable: The kernel does not expose pressure (PSI): the thresholds are saved (CPU {{cpu}}%, I/O {{io}}%, memory {{memory}}%), but throttling does not act on this server.

engines.title: Engines
engines.subtitle: Health of the detection engines, rule and signature versions and the self-test of the last scan.
engines.executorDown: The executor did not respond: the engine status could not be queried.
engines.executorDownAction: Check the service on the server with {{command}}.
engines.emptyDescription: The server returned no engines. Check that the executor is running.
engines.cacheNote: The server queries the engines at most once a minute. Data fetched

guidance.clamdFallback: The clamd service did not respond and scanning is using clamscan, which is much slower. Check that the clamd service is active on the server; the detail above shows the reported error.
guidance.selftestFailed: The last scan's self-test failed: the engine may not be detecting threats. Open the run shown to see why and scan again after fixing it.
guidance.yaraMissing: YARA-X is not available to the executor. The detail above shows why (yr program missing or rules with errors).
guidance.clamavMissing: ClamAV is not available to the executor: neither clamd nor clamscan responded. The detail above shows why.
